exposure: Robson Ten-Group Classification System (groups I, II, III, V)
Indications for Cesarean Section (Previous Cesarean, Fetal Distress)
Onset of labor (spontaneous, induced, pre-labor CS)
outcome: contribution of Robson groups to overall CS rate
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered past the period of viability (>28 weeks) at a tertiary care teaching hospital between January 2024 and December 2024.
finding: The overall institutional Cesarean Section rate was 62.3%, significantly exceeding the WHO recommendation, primarily driven by the high CS rate and large size of Robson Group V (previous CS) and Group II (induced nulliparous women).
mod_finding: The institutional Cesarean Section rate was 62.3%, with Robson Group V (previous CS) and Group II (induced nulliparous women) being the largest contributors to this high rate.
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively for deliveries between January 2024 and December 2024.
gest_age: >28 weeks gestation for all participants, with specific Robson groups defined as 'term'.
